item.name: MP-04 Project data is isolated by Mentor

request.description: TC-MP-04: uses Mentor 1 token. Current seed data assigns ids 1 and 3 to Mentor 1 and id 2 to Mentor 3.

exec: pm.test('Mentor 1 sees only own project ids',()=>{pm.response.to.have.status(200);const b=pm.response.json();const ids=b.data.map(x=>x.id);pm.expect(ids).to.include(1);pm.expect(ids).to.include(3);pm.expect(ids).to.not.include(2);});

request.description: TC-MP-05: run scripts/postman_mentor_projects_fixtures.sql first. Fixture projects use slugs qa-postman-mp-boundary-*.

exec: pm.test('All four progress boundary fixtures are returned unchanged',()=>{pm.response.to.have.status(200);const a=pm.response.json().data;const f=a.filter(x=>x.title.startsWith('QA POSTMAN MP Boundary '));const got=Object.fromEntries(f.map(x=>[Number(x.title.split(' ').pop()),x]));[0,1,99,100].forEach(v=>{pm.expect(got[v],`progress ${v}`).to.exist;pm.expect(got[v].progressPercentage).to.eql(v);['id','title','progressPercentage'].forEach(k=>pm.expect(got[v]).to.have.property(k));});});

item.description:
Equivalence Partitioning + BVA test cases for GET /api/mentor/projects.
Covers: multi-project mentor, single-project mentor, no-project mentor, data isolation, progress boundaries (0/1/99/100), auth negative cases (no token, empty bearer, malformed JWT, expired JWT, invalid signature, wrong roles: TALENT/ENTERPRISE/LAB_ADMIN/SYSTEM_ADMIN), and mentor without profile.
Source: DuyManh - LabODC_API_Testing

item.name: 10b - MentorInvitations (DuyManh EP-BVA)
MI-01/02/05 Mentor 1: fixture, order, DTO defaults

request.description: Requires the QA-POSTMAN-MI fixtures from scripts/postman_mentor_invitations_fixtures.sql. Checks Mentor 1 sees both of its pending rows, newest first, all DTO fields, and normalization of fixture B.

exec: const body = pm.response.json(); const data = body.data || [];
pm.test('Success envelope contains array', function () { pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(data).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('Fixture A is visible', function () { pm.expect(data.some(x => x.groupName === 'QA-POSTMAN-MI-A')).to.eql(true); });

pm.test('Two fixtures sorted by receivedDate descending', function () { pm.expect(fixtures.length).to.eql(2); const dates=fixtures.map(x=>x.receivedDate); pm.expect(dates).to.eql([...dates].sort().reverse()); });

pm.test('All DTO fields are present', function () { fixtures.forEach(x => ['id','projectName','groupName','studentCount','description','deadline','skills','receivedDate','priority'].forEach(k => pm.expect(x).to.have.property(k))); });

pm.test('Fixture B null/default values are normalized', function () { pm.expect(b.description).to.eql(''); pm.expect(b.skills).to.eql([]); pm.expect(b.priority).to.eql('medium'); pm.expect(b.deadline).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });

item.name: MI-04b Mentor 2 cannot see Mentor 1 fixtures

request.description: Requires SQL fixtures. Confirms Mentor 2 sees C only, never A or B.

exec: pm.test('Returns 200',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(200)); const b=pm.response.json(); const groups=(b.data||[]).map(x=>x.groupName); pm.test('Sees its C fixture only among QA fixtures',()=>{pm.expect(groups).to.include('QA-POSTMAN-MI-C');pm.expect(groups).to.not.include('QA-POSTMAN-MI-A');pm.expect(groups).to.not.include('QA-POSTMAN-MI-B');});
